test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 28 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which pair does NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter cluster)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) BF-AE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f5b16fa3c70d586072952852fdcfa832dbf65ae8f4beb12e68a1f64bb5e92d8.png] 

Option 2) DH-CG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05c716a95efd7192fa6680411afcf4b682e55f944001f17e6e80b6ae4ceac492.png] 

Option 3) XB-YC

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/462158082ac6de6b10ba178c645f44a96f4897d0dff20c52a602759fe0366ae8.png] 

Option 4) TX-SW

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eacb193773381a7e4b8a4da0fa1209a4b5ff17312e0229101268c7c860a32d9e.png] 

Thus, out of all the options 'XB-YC' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
